limitations: Process energy, battery telemetry, history, and Settings privileged dependencies are deterministic fixtures. No sampling correctness or physical-hardware power-mode assertion is inferred from screenshots.
method: Production AppKit content cache plus WindowServer capture of real Classic/Regular Glass popover and Settings windows and an owned underlay in a disposable ARM GUI VM. Native window mouse events exercise ordinary and Command-click process actions; the selected whitelist button saves an exact rule, hides that name, and refills the visible rank. The actual Settings whitelist sheet adds Exact/Wildcard/Regex rules and rejects invalid regex.
